items.body:
Todo-ID: SMB-BILL-010
Phase: `PHASE_4` · Owner: Existing workorder cost/spend owner enhanced with expense evidence and separate billing source decision.

## Outcome

Small firms need receipts and job costs, but reimbursement owed to workers and amounts charged to customers are different obligations.

This is an owner-authorized later-phase implementation contract. It does not claim shipped behavior or waive existing release gates.

## Dependencies and existing work

**Implementation dependencies:** [SMB-BILL-001](https://github.com/monstercameron/human-capital-management-suite/issues/3447), [SMB-SALE-002](https://github.com/monstercameron/human-capital-management-suite/issues/3452).
**Existing TODO context:** no additional prerequisite beyond the dependency list.
**Related issues:** no exact matching implementation issue found in the reviewed inventory.

## Reuse and ownership

- `internal/domains/workorder/workorder.go` — Extend spend/cost entries and request approval to expense claim source revisions. Reuse job cost records rather than new expense ledger.
- `internal/documents/intake` — Quarantine/store receipt evidence and protect attachments. Reuse document controls.
- `internal/domains/workorderbilling/billing.go` — Use price policy to emit an approved recharge-eligibility receipt for later BILL002 consumption; do not create billing source claims here. Do not equate employee reimbursement with sales price.

**Proposed additions:** Proposed additive domain records, application ports/commands, generated transport registration, PostgreSQL migrations and contextual productui projection in the owners named above. These are planned changes, not claims of existing implementation. Concrete proposed test files: internal/domains/workorderbilling/smb_bill_010_test.go (domain/adapter semantics), internal/application/smb_bill_010_integration_test.go (served real-DB flow), and internal/humanwork/productui/smb_bill_010_browser_test.go (consumer UI). New sales/payable/accounting directories are proposed only where named; existing owner packages are enhanced in place.

## Data and lifecycle contract

ExpenseClaim references worker/contractor, job/project, incurred date, category, exact amount/currency, merchant/reference, receipt artifact, payer (worker/company), approval and correction chain. Reimbursement decision and CustomerRecharge decision are separately versioned; reimbursement execution links approved external/AP/payroll capability with observation, recharge uses customer policy/markup snapshot. Job/project attribution is optional. A standalone BusinessExpenseClaim uses tenant/legal-entity and category/cost-center attribution with its own stable claim ID; it never fabricates a work order. When later linked to a job, preserve original claim/source identity to prevent duplicate reimbursement/recharge. Cost-record mechanics and approvals remain shared with existing workorder spend owner via a typed optional-subject extension.

## API and integration contract

Proposed job.expenses.create|submit|approve|return|correct and expenses.recharge.decide|exclude emit revision-bound expense/recharge eligibility receipts. BILL002 alone consumes those receipts through billing.sources.include-expense|exclude-expense and owns actual billing claims/invoice integration. Receipt OCR may suggest fields with provenance but cannot approve or assert final amount. Reimbursement execution is BILL016; no consumer banking model.

## Required behavior

- Reject duplicated receipt/source claim according to reviewed duplicate policy with a human exception path and preserved evidence.
- Company-paid spend is not reimbursable by default; employee-payable approval does not authorize customer recharge. Missing currency/receipt-policy evidence blocks relevant approval.
- Expense correction after billing/reimbursement creates explicit deltas and independent owner repair requirements, never rewrites both sides.
- Commands authorize tenant, legal entity, resource, purpose and field access before reads that disclose data or any mutation/effect. Current authority and module enablement are rechecked at commit; guessed IDs return the standard neutral denied/not-found response.
- Use SMB-CORE-002 versioned API, expected revision and tenant-scoped idempotency semantics: same canonical request returns its original receipt; a reused key with changed payload is a conflict; an observed timeout never becomes an invented success. Server validates every supplied reference and amount.
- Persist domain transition, audit lineage and effect intent atomically through existing transaction/outbox boundaries; cross-store writes use owner commands and resumable orchestration, never direct foreign-table edits. New tenant tables require FORCE RLS and storage-disposition registration; immutable revisions/events require forbid_mutation.
- Expense capture/approval and recharge eligibility are a producer contract independent of downstream billing claims. Before BILL002 admission show Approved for customer recharge / Billing setup required and permit expense/reimbursement work without creating a claim/invoice; after admission display consumer receipt/status as a read projection. JOB007 may consume approved expense cost without implying customer billing completion.
- Security refusal may append the existing authorized denial/security telemetry receipt; prohibited side effects mean no domain money/state mutation, outbox business intent or provider call. Tests assert both allowed denial observability and absent unauthorized effects rather than demanding zero audit records.

## UI and UX specification

- Job Costs > Expenses and My Work > My expenses share records with role-specific views. Form labels Job, Incurred on, Category, Paid by, Amount, Currency, Receipt and Business purpose; capture/upload supports mobile and shows upload/scan state.
- Reviewer sees receipt preview, claimed values, duplicate warnings and separate Reimburse and Charge customer decisions with policy explanation. Return for changes requires note. Submit success shows claim status; reimbursement and customer-billing progress have separate badges.
- Render through existing productui, GoWebComponents SSR plus Go/WASM, governed page/widget definitions, shell and semantic theme tokens. Use contextual customer/job links, role hubs, pins and My Work; do not add a permanent global navigation destination for this story.
- Verify 1280x720, 390px and 320px, light/dark, en-US/de-DE/ar RTL. Keep currency code and unambiguous local dates/timezones visible; store canonical decimals and timestamps independently of display. Use labeled controls, semantic headings/tables, keyboard-operable actions, error summary linked to fields, visible focus, and return focus to the invoking control after dialogs.
- Bound loading with a retry action and retained filter/draft state. Distinguish no records, no matches, dependency unavailable, denied, offline, stale/conflict, pending observation and completed states. Disable money-changing submission offline with a clear explanation; never queue invisible financial effects or silently overwrite a newer revision. After success announce the durable record/status and retain a direct detail link.
- My expenses and finance Expenses support Business expense and Job expense. Job field is optional unless the category policy requires it; Business expense labels Category and Cost center instead. Examples include travel supplies or office software. Changing attribution previews existing reimbursement/recharge links and never clones the claim.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] USD 50 worker-paid approved expense at explicit 20% recharge markup emits USD50 reimbursement eligibility and a pinned customer-recharge eligibility preview USD60, with zero actual billing claims/invoices in this producer slice. BILL002 owns the later real USD60 claim/invoice proof.
- [ ] Company-paid same expense produces zero worker reimbursement; denying recharge leaves cost and excluded chargeability receipt, with no invoice creation.
- [ ] Same receipt uploaded twice warns/blocks duplicate approval and cross-tenant receipt cannot be viewed or attached.
- [ ] Cross-tenant reference injection, stale revision, denied role and crash after domain commit before HTTP response must leave either no effect or one replayable committed effect.
- [ ] With BILL002 unavailable, approving expense50 and recharge preview60 creates only source/eligibility receipts, zero billing claim/invoice/outbox billing intent, and a truthful Awaiting billing setup state. Replaying those producer receipts later lets BILL002 own one actual claim; no producer back-call or duplicate writer exists.
- [ ] A USD25 employee-paid office-supply expense with no job/project can be approved with one reimbursement eligibility receipt and zero billing claims; actual standalone reimbursement execution/settlement is proved by BILL016. Company-paid subscription expense records cost without worker obligation and creates no dummy work order.

## TDD and verification contract

**INTENT CONTEXT:** `ROLE=DOMAIN_SUPPORT; SETS=BI.WORK,BI.OPERATIONS,BI.EXPERIENCE; DIRECT=owner request 2026-10-22; WHY=Small firms need receipts and job costs, but reimbursement owed to workers and amounts charged to customers are different obligations.`.
**TEST:** `TestTodo_SMB_BILL_010`.
**TEST MATRIX:** `PRIMARY=TestTodo_SMB_BILL_010`; `UNIT=TestTodo_SMB_BILL_010_Unit`; `PROPERTY=TestTodo_SMB_BILL_010_Property`; `INTEGRATION=TestTodo_SMB_BILL_010_Integration`; `SECURITY=TestTodo_SMB_BILL_010_Security`; `RACE=TestTodo_SMB_BILL_010_Race`; `FAULT=TestTodo_SMB_BILL_010_Fault`; `BROWSER=TestTodo_SMB_BILL_010_Browser`; `CONFORMANCE=TestTodo_SMB_BILL_010_Conformance`; `MUTATION=TestTodo_SMB_BILL_010_Mutation`.
**RED:** The current system cannot satisfy this bounded story: Small firms need receipts and job costs, but reimbursement owed to workers and amounts charged to customers are different obligations. Failing tests must demonstrate USD 50 worker-paid approved expense at explicit 20% recharge markup emits USD50 reimbursement eligibility and a pinned customer-recharge eligibility preview USD60, with zero actual billing claims/invoices in this producer slice. BILL002 owns the later real USD60 claim/invoice proof.
**GREEN:** Implement the stated domain/API/UI contract and make every acceptance oracle pass with persisted state and served-route evidence.
**REFACTOR:** Keep domain meaning in the existing or explicitly proposed owning domain, share existing value/workflow/effect/UI machinery, and remove duplicate calculation or retry paths introduced during implementation.

- Target commands after implementation: go test -count=1 ./internal/domains/workorderbilling -run '^TestTodo_SMB_BILL_010($|_)'; go test -count=1 ./internal/application -run '^TestTodo_SMB_BILL_010($|_)'; go test -count=1 ./internal/humanwork/productui -run '^TestTodo_SMB_BILL_010($|_)'. Use internal/data/pgtest and task .artifacts temp/cache directories. Concurrency tests run goroutines; -race is CI-only on a supported host, not falsely claimed on Windows arm64.
- Unit/property: use the explicit numeric, status and lifecycle oracles in this issue; vary ordering, duplicate identities, quantity boundaries and missing policy inputs. Assert outputs and durable outcomes, not merely successful calls.
- Integration/API: use internal/data/pgtest with real tenant RLS connections and served generated HTTP/RPC handlers. Run the positive flow, denial, stale revision and idempotent retry, restart the owner and assert the same authoritative record and outbox state.
- Race/fault: execute concurrent commands against one expected revision or monetary remainder; inject failure before commit, after commit before reply, before external send and after ambiguous external reply where applicable. Assert unique intent/receipt, no over-allocation and recoverability.
- Browser: exercise the concrete route and controls above against the running Go server and real persisted fixture; capture post-action screenshots at all declared widths/themes/locales. Include keyboard, focus, validation, empty/error/denied/offline/conflict and long translated data. API-only stories render their consuming projection or explicitly prove unavailable UI state; no fabricated finished surface.
- Conformance/mutation: remove one tenant/authority/version check and one amount/state guard and prove named tests fail. Re-run relevant owner packages and applicable repository format/lint/coverage/endpoint/page contracts; never claim production/provider support from a simulator.

These tests are required implementation evidence, not results from this planning pass. Run the narrow packages first, then applicable repository gates. Do not close this issue from mocks, static screenshots, or contract text alone.

## Rollout and recovery

Additive schema/contract version behind tenant module capability and phase authority gates; migrate old records with explicit source/version provenance, never reinterpret legacy status as stronger truth. Enable for a synthetic two-company cohort, compare old/new projections, then opt in. Disable new commands on rollback while preserving readable history, in-flight observation/repair and original identifiers; do not reverse external effects by deleting records.

## Boundaries

- No new frontend stack, workflow kernel, connector scheduler, accounting general ledger or tax determination engine.
- No automatic Phase 1 scope expansion or claim that a provider/account has already been selected.

## Adversarial design refinement

Reviewer: `commercial_adversarial`. Final design verdict: **ACCEPTED**. This approves the implementation specification, not production code.

**Sam, 10/22:** *"All of the agreements we've been working on, see exobrain."* **All of them are in launch scope.**
**Goal:** every agreement shows up in front of the right person at the moment it's due, gets signed on a phone in under a minute, and is stored with ESIGN-grade evidence. The legal text comes only from the Legal library; the app never invents terms.

## How it works
- **Engine:** Sign Here (`servers/forms/sign_here/engine.py`, `needed.py`, `approval.py`, `pdfwork.py`, `signer_auth.py`). ESIGN/UETA's four requirements: intent (typed name + button), consent (checkbox), attribution (session email + IP + UA + **sha256 of the exact PDF served**), and retention (executed copy emailed to both sides). A signature missing name or consent is refused.
- **Front door:** the app. A due agreement is a **card** on the signer's Home, job page or call sheet (triggered by the phase engine, Module 02.1).
